prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis reveals DWT_catboost as trend champion (1.0 correlation) and overall RMSE leader (139.01), while catboost excels at seasonality capture (0.722 correlation). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (36.0) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit additive decomposition and combine complementary strengths across trend and seasonal components.
